ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is an approximately rectangular circulation schematic, with the four corners labeled upper left d, upper right c, lower left a, and lower right b respectively. The arrow of current ① on the upper side points from c to d, that is, flows leftward; the arrow of current ② on the right side points from b to c, that is, flows upward; current ③ on the lower side flows from a to b, that is, flows rightward; current ④ on the left side flows from d to a, that is, flows downward. Then reason: the stem says that places c and d have nearly equal day and night throughout the year, indicating that the upper side where c and d are located is close to the equator. Combined with the arrow directions, this ocean circulation should be a Southern Hemisphere subtropical ocean circulation. ② is located on the eastern side of the ocean, with a direction from higher latitudes toward the equator, and is a cold current. Cold currents along coasts often have a cooling and moisture-reducing effect and easily form deserts; at the same time, upwelling near cold currents is relatively strong and may also form large fishing grounds. Therefore, deserts or large fishing grounds may be distributed near current ②.

The figure below shows a schematic diagram of material circulation. <image1>
If this figure represents a certain ocean circulation, and places c and d have nearly equal day and night throughout the year, what may be distributed near current ②?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the loop has c and d on the upper side, and current ② is the right vertical current flowing north/upward toward c. From the text, c and d have almost equal day and night year-round, so treat that upper side as the equatorial belt. The arrows then show a Southern Hemisphere subtropical ocean gyre; current ② is the eastern-boundary, pole-to-equator cold current. Apply the geographic effects of cold currents: nearby coasts may have arid desert landscapes, and upwelling along the cold current may form rich fisheries. Therefore ②附近可能分布沙漠或大型渔场。
